Subject: PERL_CORE UVf logic

The following code from perl.h looks wrong 
(I wrote the comment but the code around it has been patched).

#ifdef PERL_CORE
/* not used; but needed for backward compatibility with XS code? - RMB */ 
#  ifndef UVf
#    define UVf UVuf
#  endif
#else
#  undef UVf
#endif

We only need to define UVf when PERL_CORE is false.  
The "honest" change is to replace 'ifdef' by 'ifndef'.
I imagine we could get away with deleting the whole block or replacing with '#undef UVf'

Robin Barker
